axis: ordinary annoyance → a visible flare of pique

members.tone: Names the state by what it lacks, and pins the irritation to one cause — anything that makes you wait.
The same shortage of patience heard as agitation that will not settle under delay, where *impatience* hears a demand that things move.
Formal and weighty for the state *irritation* names plainly, lending the annoyance a gravity the plainer word withholds.
The plain name for the state, carrying no verdict on whether it is deserved.
Informal and faintly belittling — a state one is *in*, flared and conspicuous, next to the settled condition *vexation* describes.
The lightest way to say it, the state at everyday strength without the weight *vexation* adds.
